task_title: Client hangup mid-response: no phantom 5xx or traceback in server log
task_criteria: A client that hangs up mid-response never yields a phantom 5xx line or a traceback: handler catches the closed-socket write and returns silently; live probe log contains zero Traceback lines

items.criterion: A client that hangs up mid-response never yields a phantom 5xx line or a traceback: handler catches the closed-socket write and returns silently; live probe log contains zero Traceback lines
items.detail: Handler catches the closed-socket write FIRST and returns silently: APIHandler.do_GET auger.py:7637-7642, APIHandler._route_post auger.py:7852-7854, EmbeddingsHTTPHandler.do_GET auger.py:1913-1917 — all before the APIError/SubstrateError/SystemExit/Exception fallbacks that would write a 5xx to the dead socket; EmbeddingsHTTPHandler._send_json also guards its own write with OSError (auger.py:2025-2030) and _QuietPeerHangupServer.handle_error (auger.py:2035-2038) silences the post-handler wfile flush / keep-alive read. Fresh live probe run in this conversation (`.venv/bin/python /tmp/aug212_probe.py`, probe_exit=0): five real TCP RST hang-ups (SO_LINGER 0) against live APIServer and EmbeddingsHTTPServer sockets — GET /api/ns/demo/status mid-response, POST /api/ns/demo/check mid-response, keep-alive RST after a complete 200, GET embeddings/search mid-response, HEAD /health mid-response. Server stderr contained ONLY the five legitimate 200 access lines; grep -c "Traceback" = 0, grep -cE '" (500|502|503) ' = 0, grep -c "Exception occurred" = 0. Fresh regression run: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_api_service.py -q -p no:randomly` -> exit 0, "11 passed in 5.63s".

items.criterion: Reachability: the hangup-silencing must be wired into BOTH real HTTP entrypoints (`auger serve` -> EmbeddingsHTTPServer/EmbeddingsHTTPHandler and `auger api` -> APIServer/APIHandler), including the post-handler wfile flush / keep-alive read path (server-level handle_error), not just the in-handler write.
items.detail: Both entrypoints wired. `auger serve` -> cmd_serve constructs EmbeddingsHTTPServer (auger.py:7195) which mixes in _QuietPeerHangupServer (auger.py:2041) and EmbeddingsHTTPHandler.do_GET catches (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError) FIRST at auger.py:1913-1917. `auger api` -> serve() constructs APIServer (auger.py:7872) with the same mixin (auger.py:7865); APIHandler.do_GET catch at auger.py:7637-7642 and the POST /check path catch at auger.py:7852-7854. Post-handler flush/keep-alive read errors are silenced only for the two hangup exceptions by _QuietPeerHangupServer.handle_error (auger.py:2035-2038). Live probes on both real server classes (this conversation's /tmp/aug212_probe.py run, exit 0) covered GET status, GET embeddings/search, HEAD /health, POST /check and a keep-alive RST after a complete 200 — only legitimate 200 access lines, zero Traceback, zero 5xx.

items.criterion: No over-silencing / no regression: non-hangup exceptions must still reach socketserver's loud default handle_error (a traceback), and the pre-existing API/serve test surface must stay green.
items.detail: No over-silencing: _QuietPeerHangupServer.handle_error (auger.py:2036-2038) returns only for BrokenPipeError/ConnectionResetError and calls super().handle_error for everything else; a deliberate non-hangup probe (namespace_status raises RuntimeError, then _send(502) raises ValueError) on APIServer still printed socketserver's full "Exception occurred during processing of request" + two Tracebacks. Regression surface green: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_api_service.py -q -p no:randomly` -> exit 0, "11 passed in 5.63s" (re-run fresh in this conversation); earlier runs on the same tree: tests/test_auger.py -k 'serve or http or server or embeddings' -> exit 0, "7 passed, 348 deselected in 18.62s"; tests/test_openapi_parity.py -> exit 0, "11 passed in 0.19s"; `ruff check auger.py tests/test_api_service.py` -> "All checks passed!"; `ruff format --check auger.py` -> "1 file already formatted". Tier-1 full gate (bash tests/gate.sh) also passed per the task's recorded prior_findings (exit_code 0, GATE PASS).

items.criterion: The new hangup regression tests must actually detect the defect: the identical RST-mid-response probe against the pre-fix base (7b003e4) must produce the phantom 5xx line and Traceback that the fixed code suppresses.
items.detail: Control run of the identical RST-mid-response probe against the pre-fix base (`git show 7b003e4:auger.py > /tmp/auger_base_7b003e4.py`, imported and served) printed `127.0.0.1 "GET /api/ns/demo/status HTTP/1.1" 502 -` (the phantom 5xx) followed by "Exception occurred during processing of request" and TWO chained Tracebacks (ConnectionResetError in end_headers, then BrokenPipeError in the 502 fallback). The same probe against the fixed auger.py printed only the 200 line and nothing else, so tests/test_api_service.py:296-310 (_assert_no_phantom_5xx_no_traceback) has teeth; both new tests (test_api_client_hangup_mid_response_is_silent, test_serve_client_hangup_mid_response_is_silent) pass on the fixed tree in this conversation's run (11 passed).
